Step:  
02-06-1283 is 2 June 1283.  
Subtract 41 days:  
June has 30 days, so back to 22 May (2 June - 11 days = 22 May).  
Remaining days to subtract: 41 - 11 = 30 days.  
22 May - 30 days = 22 May → 22 April (30 days earlier).  
Check: April 1283 had 30 days, so 22 April is correct.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1283-04-22
